preparation.base: Isolated Python 3.14 virtualenv with unmodified upstream STRkit v0.25.0 installed from source (`pip install .`)
preparation.without_preparation: Automated verification stopped before installation (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) because `README.md` only documents PyPI (`python -m pip install strkit`) and Docker (`ghcr.io/davidlougheed/strkit:latest`) installation rather than a copyable source install command (`pip install .`) for the cloned repository.
why: The automated run stopped before installation (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) because `README.md` documents installing from PyPI (`python -m pip install strkit`) or running a prebuilt Docker image (`ghcr.io/davidlougheed/strkit:latest`), rather than a single copyable source-installation command (`pip install .`) targeting the cloned repository.

Additionally, `pyproject.toml` declares a local `[tool.uv.sources]` path (`../strkit_rust_ext/`) for workspace development, whereas standard `pip install .` resolves `strkit_rust_ext==0.30.1` cleanly from PyPI without requiring a sibling Rust checkout.
steps: Cloned `https://github.com/davidlougheed/strkit` and checked out commit `c6b6ef1a878cac2fed5f41637553d51caa3403d1` without modifying any tracked or untracked files.

Created an isolated Python 3.14 virtual environment and installed the checkout from source (`pip install /src/strkit`), which installed `strkit==0.25.0` together with the prebuilt `strkit_rust_ext==0.30.1` wheel, `pysam`, `scipy`, `scikit-learn`, `statsmodels`, and `parasail`.
Staged the indexed ONT R10 SUP CODIS BAM (`HG00113.codis.bam` + `.bai`), indexed `hg38.fa` (+ `.fai`), and STRhub's 4-column `motif.bed` catalog (20 CODIS loci) in `/data/in`.
Executed `strkit call` with `--realign --seed 183 --processes 4 --vcf /data/out/sample.vcf` and verified all 20/20 CODIS loci in the resulting VCF.

recommendations: Add a short "Install from source" code block in `README.md` (for example `python -m pip install .` after cloning) alongside the PyPI and Docker instructions so automated verifiers and reviewers can build directly from a pinned commit.

Document a minimal, self-contained `strkit call` example without optional external catalogs (`--incorporate-snvs` dbSNP VCF and `--annotation-file` GFF3) so first-time users and automated runners can smoke-test the caller with only a BAM, reference FASTA, and 4-column BED.

verdict.title: Runs in manual verification
verdict.reason: Installed unmodified upstream STRkit v0.25.0 (`c6b6ef1`) into an isolated Python virtual environment (`pip install .`, zero source modifications) and ran `strkit call` with `--realign --seed 183 --processes 4` against the HG00113 Oxford Nanopore R10 SUP CODIS reference slice (`ont-bam-hg38`, 20 autosomal CODIS loci in 4-column `motif.bed` format) and local `hg38.fa`. Execution completed cleanly in ~4.4 s (exit 0), producing a valid 20-record VCF (`sample.vcf`) with 20/20 called diploid genotypes and 702 total supporting reads (`FORMAT/DP`, mean depth 35.1x).

conclusion.title: strkit v0.25.0 executes end-to-end

conclusion.title: Output passes plausibility checks
conclusion.body: The run produced a structurally valid, non-empty VCF output containing 20 distinct recognizable STR loci; structural plausibility checks verify output format and locus presence, not genotype accuracy.

conclusion.title: Verification used STRhub reference data

conclusion.title: Repeatability of this manual run
conclusion.body: The pinned upstream commit, prepared environment description, exact commands executed, and sanitized terminal output recorded in this report document the procedure for independent reproduction.

limitations: Results apply exclusively to the exact Git commit SHA and manually prepared environment recorded in this report.
Single regional reference slice per input type; low-coverage warnings on sliced BAMs do not imply defects on whole-genome data.
Plausible Output checks verify structural format and recognizable STR loci, not biological genotype truth.
Verification is a point-in-time snapshot; upstream repository changes after this commit are not covered until re-verification.
No truth-set concordance, forensic casework validation, or regulatory compliance assessment was performed.

es.plain_why: STRkit v0.25.0 se instala limpiamente desde el repositorio fijado con `pip install .` y genotipifica los 20/20 loci CODIS del slice de referencia ONT R10 SUP sin modificar el código fuente.
es.without_preparation: La verificación automática se detuvo antes de la instalación (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) porque `README.md` solo documenta la instalación vía PyPI (`python -m pip install strkit`) o Docker (`ghcr.io/davidlougheed/strkit:latest`), sin un comando copiable de instalación desde el repositorio clonado (`pip install .`).
recommendations: Agregar un bloque breve de instalación desde el código fuente en `README.md` (por ejemplo `python -m pip install .` tras clonar el repositorio) junto a las instrucciones de PyPI y Docker para que los verificadores automáticos y revisores puedan compilar directamente desde un commit fijado.

Documentar un ejemplo mínimo autocontenido de `strkit call` sin catálogos externos opcionales (`--incorporate-snvs` con dbSNP ni `--annotation-file` GFF3) para que nuevos usuarios y corridas automáticas puedan probar el caller solo con BAM, FASTA de referencia y BED de 4 columnas.

pt.plain_why: STRkit v0.25.0 instala-se limpamente a partir do repositório fixado via `pip install .` e genotipa todos os 20/20 loci CODIS no recorte de referência ONT R10 SUP sem modificar o código-fonte.
pt.without_preparation: A verificação automática parou antes da instalação (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) porque o `README.md` documenta apenas a instalação via PyPI (`python -m pip install strkit`) ou Docker (`ghcr.io/davidlougheed/strkit:latest`), sem um comando copiável de instalação a partir do repositório clonado (`pip install .`).
recommendations: Adicionar um bloco curto de instalação a partir do código-fonte no `README.md` (por exemplo `python -m pip install .` após clonar) ao lado das instruções de PyPI e Docker para que verificadores automáticos e revisores possam instalar diretamente de um commit fixado.

Documentar um exemplo mínimo autocontido de `strkit call` sem catálogos externos opcionais (`--incorporate-snvs` dbSNP e `--annotation-file` GFF3) para que novos usuários e execuções automáticas possam testar a ferramenta apenas com BAM, FASTA de referência e BED de 4 colunas.
